description: The pie chart depicts the breakdown of an average total time cost into two categories related to efficient deployment, showing 2 slices in total. One slice is labeled “Efficient deployment,” colored blue, and is annotated inside the slice as 26.2s (30.08%). The other slice is labeled “Reduction,” colored orange, and is annotated as 60.9s (69.92%). The chart places the numeric value and percentage labels directly within each slice and does not show a separate legend; the slices are separated by a prominent white boundary, and the smaller blue segment appears slightly offset from the rest of the pie.
